priorityList: --- Icy Veins Rotation (Priority List) ---
Pre-cast Living Flame so that it lands on pull.
Cast Deep Breath.
Cast Dragonrage.
Cast Fire Breath with Tip the Scales.
Cast Eternity Surge.
Cast Disintegrate until you run out of Essence.
Cast Azure Sweep to gain a charge of Essence Burst.
Cast Living Flame to gain charges of Essence Burst when you have no Azure Sweep.
Cast Deep Breath a second time.
Proceed with your normal rotation according to the list below.
Use Fire Breath empower level 1 on cooldown in order to maintain the damage over time effect.
Use Eternity Surge on cooldown.
Use Hover to maintain uptime whenever you are forced to move.
Use Azure Sweep when available.
Use Living Flame as a filler.
Use Azure Strike as a filler when moving if you have no Hover.
Cast Deep Breath once the enemies are grouped up.
Cast Eternity Surge at either rank 1 or matching the amount of targets. Since you are running Eternity's Span this will mean 2/4/6 targets for rank 1/2/3 respectively.
Cast Fire Breath at rank 1 or with Tip the Scales.
Cast Azure Sweep when available to deal large damage and generate Essence Burst.
Cast Azure Strike as a filler and to give you Essence Burst procs which you will spend on Pyre.
Cast Living Flame with Burnout procs when you have your stacks of Leaping Flames up from casting Fire Breath, this will give you maximum Essence Burst stacks.
Cast empowered spells on cooldown and avoid overcapping Essence.
Pre-Cast Living Flame .
Cast Fire Breath at Empower level 1.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empower level 1.
Cast Disintegrate three times.
Cast Disintegrate until out of Essence.
Cast Azure Sweep
Cast Fire Breath on cooldown, always at Empower level 1.
Cast Eternity Surge on cooldown.
Cast Disintegrate as your Essence spender.
Cast Azure Sweep when available.
Cast Living Flame as your filler.
Cast Azure Strike if you have to cast whilst moving without any Hover charges.
Dragonrage is sent on cooldown.
Fire Breath is always cast at Empower level 1 to maximize the damage of Consume Flame.
Pyre on everything above 3 targets, switch to Disintegrate if the pack is down to 2 targets or less.
Living Flame cast at least once between every Fire Breath cast in order to consume Leaping Flames
Azure Sweep cast when available.
Eternity Surge cast when you have none of the above available.

Dragonrage.

Eternity Surge.
Fire Breath Rank 1.
Channel Disintegrate, or cast Pyre for AoE.
Dragonrage is now active, continue to the normal rotation.
